items.details: The remaster adds modern targeting, a full map and mission retry after failure, but it does not provide a normal menu for replaying a successfully completed story mission. Keep separate manual saves before the four Portland trophy challenges and the later contact cutoffs. A retry prompt is not a replacement for a pre-mission recovery save. Play without cheats for trophies, and save side-activity progress manually rather than assuming autosave preserves every pickup or vehicle-service attempt.

items.details: Claude still cannot swim in the Definitive Edition. Deep water is not an escape route from police, and a vehicle entering it can end an otherwise successful mission. Slow down near the docks and keep room to turn a car around. For boat transfers, bring the hull alongside a low landing before stepping out; do not jump toward a distant shore. Keep a recovery save before unfamiliar water missions.

details_i18n.pt: Claude continua sem saber nadar na Definitive Edition. Água profunda não é uma rota de fuga da polícia, e entrar nela com um veículo pode encerrar uma missão que estava indo bem. Reduza a velocidade perto das docas e deixe espaço para manobrar. Ao trocar o barco por terra firme, encoste o casco em um desembarque baixo antes de sair; não salte em direção a uma margem distante. Preserve um salvamento de recuperação antes de missões aquáticas desconhecidas.

items.details: For a 100% run, use a separate save before the three major availability changes. Finish Luigi and Joey before Salvatore's Last Requests; following the full Toni strand first is also the safe Portland route. Finish all five Kenji assignments before Donald's Waka-Gashira Wipeout!, and finish Asuka's Two-Faced Tanner before Grand Theft Aero. The optional contact category lists these ten permanently missable jobs separately. A later safehouse save does not restore a lost contact; an earlier save is the straightforward recovery.

items.details: Bring the requested funds to 8-Ball, take him to the harbor and climb the warehouse roof facing the ship before firing. Your first shot starts his advance, so identify the guards before beginning. Clear the two guards near the boarding approach, then quickly work along the deck so nobody can shoot him as he moves forward. Prioritize enemies with a clear line to 8-Ball rather than distant targets. Keep the sniper view controlled and avoid explosions close to him. If he dies, the mission fails even if you survive.

details_i18n.pt: Leve o dinheiro solicitado a 8-Ball, acompanhe-o ao porto e suba ao teto do armazém de frente para o navio antes de disparar. Elimine os dois próximos do acesso ao navio e avance rapidamente pela tripulação no convés, impedindo que atirem nele. Priorize inimigos com visão direta de 8-Ball em vez de alvos distantes. Portland activities remain available, but an ambulance, race car or delivery van can be destroyed very quickly when passing Mafia territory. For an easier 100% route, finish Paramedic and El Burro's Portland jobs early, preferably before other gang hostility has escalated as well. This is a difficulty warning, distinct from Luigi and Joey's permanent Last Requests lockout.

items.details: Collect the supplied Rocket Launcher before taking the boat to the marked airport approach. The ambulance carries three patients at once, so group pickups into sensible trips back to the hospital. Brake early near patients and hospital doors: running over a patient ends the attempt, and collisions waste precious time. Save before starting and after a successful finish.
